messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: Is there any problem with my estimated model?
parts:
Hi
you tested a saturated model (all possible parameters are estimated in your model, this is similar to multiple regression) and so your df is 0. note that in saturated model fit indices are perfect. If this is your goal no problem. If not , you have to share your model and syntax to look by members of groups. HTH

messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: Is there any problem with my estimated model?
parts:
Hi
There are some problems with me in your model:
1- you clarify your dependent variables as ordered, do you think they are ordinal variables? If so, no problem. 
2- In your theoretical model all indicators related to demographic variables (and other independent variables) are not present, while in your command you insert all of them for all dependent variables. if this happened just for summary, no problem.

as i told before you have checked a saturated model, so your df is 0 and your fit indices are in maximum. of course no evaluation you can do with saturated models. 
just check if your dependent variables are ordinal or not. otherwise you run your path analysis correctly. HTH
